title: Radar back-analysis tool for slope alarms
summary: An Excel workbook that averages radar velocity data over windows from 30 minutes to 12 hours, then counts false alarms and warning time for each threshold. Results show as a heat map so the best alarm settings are easy to pick.

title: SG 10116 chrome project, Lalapanzi, Zimbabwe
summary: Tailings storage facility and slime dam design for a chrome operation, with A3 drawings of the dam, plant process flow and 3D plant layout.

title: West Shore Gold financial model
summary: A full Excel valuation of a 25-year heap leach gold operation: production schedule, operating and capital costs, tax, cash flow, NPV and sensitivity.

title: Radar coverage planning tool
summary: A tool for planning where slope radars should sit so the active pit walls stay covered as mining moves.
